title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (August 2026)
summary: Hacker News monthly 'Who's Hiring?' megathread for August 2026 - a community-driven job board where company employees directly post openings, excluding recruiters and job boards. The thread enforces rules for location transparency and requires active engagement with applicants.
problem_solved: Connects tech talent directly with hiring companies while filtering out recruiters and ensuring authentic job postings with clear location/remote policies.
why_valuable: Provides a trusted, low-friction hiring channel for the tech community with built-in accountability through direct employee posting and active reply requirements.
